data.title: 砂狼白子 · 阿拜多斯黄昏的围巾与暮风
data.description: 夕阳沉入广袤阿拜多斯沙海的壮美时刻，金色晚霞染红了废弃校舍的屋顶。白子身穿制服站在风中，青色围巾随强劲的暮风烈烈飞舞。微风撩起银白短发，狼耳敏锐地辨别着远方的风声。她单手按住被风吹拂的制服裙摆，转头注视着身旁的老师，眼神如荒漠泉水般澄澈见底。
data.location: rooftop of abandoned desert school building looking out at endless sand dunes
data.action: standing at rooftop edge against blazing orange sunset, blue scarf blowing wildly in wind, holding down skirt hem, silver hair whipped by breeze, calm soulful expression
data.lighting: dramatic fiery desert sunset backlighting figure with glowing golden rim light
data.mood: epic nostalgic wasteland romance, unwavering silent devotion
data.promptProse: Standing on the edge of a desert school rooftop at golden sunset, Sunaookami Shiroko watches the sand dunes glow red. Her signature blue scarf billows in the wind as her blue eyes turn with deep, unspoken loyalty.
data.animaCaption: Shiroko standing on a desert school rooftop at sunset, her blue scarf dancing in the wind.
